chapters.title: Stack each group

frames.caption: Stack each group — O(n) time, O(k) extra space. Input: reverse_k_group(head=list (1), k=2). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
tail.next = tail = stack.pop() — tail moves to (2); (2) popped off the end of stack
tail.next = tail = stack.pop() — tail moves to (1); (1) popped off the end of stack
tail.next = tail = stack.pop() — tail moves to (4); (4) popped off the end of stack
tail.next = tail = stack.pop() — tail moves to (3); (3) popped off the end of stack
while probe and len(stack) < k: → false (k = 2, probe = None)
tail.next = node (short tail group stays as is)

chapters.title: Recursive

frames.caption: Recursive — O(n) time, O(n / k) extra space. Input: reverse_k_group(head=list (1), k=2). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
prev, cur = reverse_k_group(node, k), head — calls reverse_k_group(head=(3), k=2)
prev, cur = reverse_k_group(node, k), head — calls reverse_k_group(head=(5), k=2)
return head — reverse_k_group returns (5) to reverse_k_group (fewer than k: leave as is)
for _ in range(k): — head moves to (3); node moves to (5); _ = 0
cur.next, prev, cur = prev, cur, cur.next — prev moves to (3); cur moves to (4)
cur.next, prev, cur = prev, cur, cur.next — prev moves to (4); cur moves to (5)
for _ in range(k): — head moves to (1); node moves to (3); _ = 0; cur moves to (1)
cur.next, prev, cur = prev, cur, cur.next — prev moves to (1); cur moves to (2)
cur.next, prev, cur = prev, cur, cur.next — prev moves to (2); cur moves to (3)

chapters.title: Iterative, group by group

frames.caption: Iterative, group by group — O(n) time, O(1) extra space. Input: reverse_k_group(head=list (1), k=2). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
cur.next, prev, cur = prev, cur, cur.next — prev moves to (1); cur moves to (2)
cur.next, prev, cur = prev, cur, cur.next — prev moves to (2); cur moves to (3)
cur.next, prev, cur = prev, cur, cur.next — prev moves to (3); cur moves to (4)
cur.next, prev, cur = prev, cur, cur.next — prev moves to (4); cur moves to (5)
